name: Troubled
source: A guy who is looked down on tries to prove himself to his parents by living on his own and going to a new school. In Yukai High, he meets people who can change his life entirely. He can get a girlfriend or have a good friend. It's up to you, will you succeed to prove himself to his parents?
translation: 一个饱受轻视的男孩决定独自生活并转入新学校，试图向父母证明自己的能力。在友海高中，他遇见了一群能够彻底改变自己人生的人。他可以交到女朋友，也可以结交挚友。接下来就看你的选择了——他能否成功向父母证明自己？
